Maximize severe true positives, then minimize nonsevere classification errors, then overall correct count, macro-F1 and declared order. If none qualify preserve baseline with explicit failure flag. Both policies reported.
scope: Reuse verified original features, participant folds and baseline outer checkpoints. Regenerate only missing inner probabilities. No new augmentation method; two baseline-selected pipelines may replay their already declared severe interpolation. New weighting and ordinal candidates use real fitting participants only. Thresholds never use outer labels.
limitations: Post-final exploratory study after repeated searches. Inner harm constraints do not guarantee held-out harm bounds. Same seven severe people in each repeat. No independent evaluation or deployment promotion.
